note: Questions are phrased so that YES means compliant. A rule that is not triggered by the situation counts as compliant. Audit questions are independently re-worded; the audit judge must use these and must never be used to choose edits. Weights are equal by default.

rules.name: return window
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid offering a return or refund for a non-defective item that was delivered more than 30 days ago?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that, once 30 days have passed since delivery, the reply never grants a return or refund on an item that is not defective?

rules.name: defect photo
rules.main_question: If the customer reports a defective or damaged item, does the reply ask for at least one photo of the problem?
rules.audit_question: When a customer says an item is broken or damaged, does the reply request photographic evidence?

rules.name: item condition
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid accepting the return of a used or washed non-defective item?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that the reply does not agree to take back a worn, used or laundered item that is not defective?

rules.name: final sale
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid offering a return or refund for a non-defective item marked Final Sale or Clearance?
rules.audit_question: For an item sold as Final Sale or Clearance and not defective, does the reply refuse to grant a return or refund?

rules.name: refund method
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid offering cash, gift cards or any payout other than the original payment method?
rules.audit_question: Does the reply restrict any refund to the customer's original form of payment, without offering cash or a gift card?

rules.name: processing time
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid promising a refund in fewer than 5 business days?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that the reply never states or implies that a refund will arrive sooner than five business days?

rules.name: shipping costs
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid promising a prepaid return label or a shipping-fee refund unless the item is defective or the wrong item was sent?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that free return shipping or reimbursement of shipping is offered only for defective items or our own shipping mistakes?

rules.name: order number
rules.main_question: If the reply processes or starts a return or refund, does it ask for or confirm the order number?
rules.audit_question: When the reply begins handling a return or refund, does it request or verify the customer's order number?

rules.name: sensitive information
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid asking the customer for a full card number, a CVV or a password?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that the reply never requests the customer's complete card number, security code or password?

rules.name: large refunds
rules.main_question: If the refund is over 500 US dollars, does the reply avoid approving it directly and say a supervisor will review it?
rules.audit_question: For a refund above $500, does the reply leave the decision to a supervisor instead of approving it itself?

rules.name: inspection
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid guaranteeing that a refund will be approved before the returned item is inspected?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that the reply does not promise approval of a refund ahead of inspecting the item?

rules.name: respectful tone
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid blaming, accusing or criticizing the customer?
rules.audit_question: Is the reply free of any wording that puts fault on the customer or scolds them?

rules.name: warranty
rules.main_question: Does the reply avoid claiming warranty coverage for a non-electronics item or promising coverage longer than one year?
rules.audit_question: Is it true that warranty coverage is claimed only for electronics and never for more than one year?

rules.name: gift purchases
rules.main_question: For a gift purchase, does the reply avoid giving a cash refund to anyone other than the original purchaser?
rules.audit_question: When an item was a gift, is a money refund offered only to the person who bought it, with at most store credit for the recipient?

rules.name: next step
rules.main_question: Does the reply end by stating one clear next step for the customer?
rules.audit_question: Is the final part of the reply a single, clear action that the customer should take next?
